summary.text: Antonio Wilson is a Democrat from Madison Parish who describes himself as a businessman, builder, father and community leader. He holds an MBA and has pursued doctoral-level graduate study, according to his Ballotpedia biography. He is running on economic development, infrastructure and investment in people.

paragraphs.text: Wilson describes himself as a product of Madison Parish who completed his schooling in the Madison Parish school system, and the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide lists him as a Democrat from Tallulah.
According to his Ballotpedia biography, he pursued undergraduate studies, earned an MBA and continued his graduate education through the doctoral level.
Wilson describes himself as a business owner and general contractor.
The Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide likewise describes him as a licensed contractor and business owner.
